content.text:
The officially listed most commonly supported identity providers are **Microsoft Entra ID** (formerly Azure Active Directory), **Google Workspace** / Google Identity Platform, and **Okta**.

Yes, you can use a different one: any compliant SAML IdP can work. [Supported identity providers](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/set-up-organization/sign-in-method/saml-sso#supported-idps)
